final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: IREF sink (unit NMOS cell W=5 L=1)
MB0 ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=5  L=1
* tail current source (2x unit = 20 uA)
M5  tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=5  L=1 m=2
* NMOS input pair (vinp = non-inverting)
M1  na    vinn  tail vss nfet W=10 L=1
M2  n1    vinp  tail vss nfet W=10 L=1
* PMOS mirror load
M3  na    na    vdd  vdd pfet W=8  L=1
M4  n1    na    vdd  vdd pfet W=8  L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink (120 uA)
M7  vout  n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=8  L=1 m=12
M8  vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=5  L=1 m=12
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  n1    nz    2.5k
Cc  nz    vout  1.2p
.ends
